author: Splades
body:
As the title says, if you could have any ms, what would it be?

Honestly I'd have anywhere from 80ms-150ms because that's where you basically take 0 knockback but your hits still register. Sure 300ms you take no knockback but each hit takes atleast 2 seconds to register. So yeah I'd have 80ms-150ms (or whatever dagger has.)
